question: 我正驾驶一辆客车行驶在这条公路上，当前时间为上午10点。根据规定，我需要在前方70公里处的休息点进行轮换，由我的徒弟继续驾驶。然而徒弟胆怯，只能保持车辆的最低限速行驶。请问，若要以最短时间抵达110公里外的目的地，我最早何时能到达？

steps.description: Locate the speed limit sign in the image and read the maximum speed value displayed
Locate the minimum speed limit sign in the image and read the minimum speed value displayed
Find the text describing the distance to the rest stop and extract the numerical value
Find the text describing the destination distance and extract the numerical value
Read the current time mentioned in the question text
Divide the distance to rest stop by the maximum speed to calculate travel time in hours
Convert the travel time from hours to minutes
Add the travel time to the current time to determine arrival at rest stop
Subtract the rest stop distance from the total destination distance to find remaining distance
Divide the remaining distance by the minimum speed to calculate apprentice's driving time
Add the apprentice's driving time to the rest stop arrival time to get final arrival time
